metadata_predictor.note: A metadata predictor is a construction diagnostic. High accuracy does not rewrite confirmatory PASS; it constrains how much of the result could be read from public fields rather than projections.

note: Phase A verifies the frozen confirmatory result. It is not a V2 experiment archive.

secondary_baselines.note: Secondary baselines cannot rewrite the frozen confirmatory claim. Unimplemented stronger baselines remain CANNOT_CHECK.

exact_coordinate_conservative.reason: merge only if every exposed coordinate is exactly equal; otherwise UNRESOLVED

executable_schema_contracts_like.reason: provenance-aware schema-contract baseline is not faithfully implemented; stub only

flat_predicate_canonicalization.reason: equal normalized predicate implies merge; otherwise UNRESOLVED

provenance_world_attributed_statements.reason: provenance-world/attributed-statement reasoning is not faithfully implemented; stub only

scion_like_conservative_schema_fusion.reason: SCION-like evidence-linked fusion is not faithfully implemented; stub only
